verdict.rationale: sevDesk documents a REST API with human-facing API documentation, but nothing in the evidence shows a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent machine-readable spec. Probes of the common OpenAPI and Swagger paths on api.sevdesk.de all returned 404. Having an API and docs is adjacent to this story, not the spec itself, so the verdict is none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
